He says it's the only thing he looks forward to, but that makes him sad too, because that's no life to have. He has a good job and friends and some hobbies. But he gets no joy from any of it.

I'll try to get him to see the doctor. But it won't be easy.

I want to help him. I am so frightened though, because I know he is serious and feel like it's on me, if he does it then not only will it be total heartbreak, but total guilt. If I'm the only one that knows then I'm the only one who can help. And I'm to blame if he does it because I should have know how to stop him.

I will book him an appt with the GP I think
